HA: High availability: the service stays up when one machine fails, because another one takes over its work.
VIP: Virtual IP: the one address clients use. Keepalived moves it from one load balancer to the other when the first fails.
HAProxy: The load balancer in front of the Pentaho nodes. It checks each node's health and pins every client to one node with a cookie.
Keepalived: The service that holds the virtual IP on one balancer and moves it to the other, using the VRRP protocol.
sticky session: A client's requests always go to the same Pentaho node. Mandatory here: Pentaho sessions are not replicated between nodes.
cluster journal: The table in the shared repository where each Jackrabbit node records its changes, so the other nodes can apply them.
Quartz: The Pentaho Server's scheduler. Clustered through its shared tables, it fires each schedule once across the cluster.
Carte: Pentaho Data Integration's lightweight server: it runs and monitors transformations and jobs, and answers a REST API.
PUC: Pentaho User Console - the Pentaho Server's browser UI where published content is browsed, run, and scheduled.
PDI: Pentaho Data Integration (Kettle) - the ETL side of the platform: Spoon designer, Kitchen/Pan runners, Carte server.
